projects.title: 🚀 Lead Funnel — landing page + multi-step form
projects.description:
Marketing landing page with a 3-step application form: per-step validation, progress bar, anti-spam honeypot. Submissions are saved to Postgres (Neon) and instantly pushed to a Telegram group by this same bot token — the two projects work as one system.

Stack: Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Postgres, Telegram Bot API.

projects.title: 📊 Price Watch Bot — this bot
projects.description:
Scheduled monitor that polls a public JSON API (default: Bitcoin/USD), detects changes or threshold crossings, and alerts a Telegram channel. Runs free on GitHub Actions cron with state persisted between runs — no server needed. This portfolio menu you are using right now is part of the same codebase.

Stack: Python 3, requests, Telegram Bot API, GitHub Actions.
